label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 228 ]

blocks.text: "People often think that being an usher is an easy job, but it isn't." says Peter Suilivan, an usher at the Palladium theater. " It's difficult to stand so much! When I'm tired, I sit in an aisle seat during intermission, but my boss could fire me for that.

readingSentences.english: "People think ushering is an easy job, but it is not," says Peter Sullivan, an usher at the Palladium Theater.
readingSentences.korean: "사람들은 안내원이 쉬운 직업이라고 생각하지만 결코 그렇지 않습니다,"라고 팔라디움 극장의 안내원인 피터 설리번은 말한다.

readingSentences.english: "Standing so long is hard! When I'm tired, I sometimes sit in an aisle seat during intermission, but the boss could fire me for that."
readingSentences.korean: "그렇게 오래 서 있는 것은 정말 힘듭니다! 피곤할 때는 휴식 시간에 통로 좌석에 앉기도 하지만, 사장님은 그 일로 저를 해고할 수도 있지요."
